name.zh: Ashmand 所译托勒密的分点星座

definition.en: This edition calls Aries and Libra equinoctial signs, with the rationale preserved in the cited sentence.
definition.zh: 此版本称白羊座与天秤座为分点星座，所引整句保留其解释理由。

tradition.en: Ptolemy through the paraphrase attributed to Proclus, Ashmand's 1822 English translation; single-source historical record.
tradition.zh: 托勒密经被归于 Proclus 的转述本，由 Ashmand 于 1822 年译为英文；单源历史记录。

limits.en: Non-executable. The historical equal-day/night explanation is not a guarantee about observed daylight. It defines neither modern sign classification nor a house system or a chart interpretation.
limits.zh: 不可执行。历史原文的昼夜等长说法不保证实际日照时长；它不定义现代星座归属算法、宫制或命盘解释。

lineage.en: Project-authored request identifiers and bilingual contracts; not independent astronomical or traditional corroboration.
lineage.zh: 项目自写的请求标识与双语合同，不是独立的天文或传统互证。

rights.en: Project-authored text under the repository MIT license.
rights.zh: 项目自写文本，采用本仓 MIT 许可证。

scope.en: Supports existing configuration identities and validation contracts only, not future calculations or historical definitions.
scope.zh: 仅支持已有配置身份及校验合同，不支持未来计算或历史定义。

scope.en: One historical sign-grouping statement in Book I, chapter XIV, not an empirical claim, independent multi-source consensus or applicable chart conclusion.
scope.zh: 《第一卷》第 XIV 章的一条历史星座分组陈述，不是实证主张、多源共识或适用于命盘的结论。

statement.en: Body provides physical-object request identifiers; mathematical lunar nodes are separate identities.

exceptions.en: A mathematical node must not be passed as a Body.
exceptions.zh: 数学交点不能当作 Body 传入。

limits.en: These are request identities, not computed positions or an astronomical classification table.
limits.zh: 这是请求标识，不是已算出的位置或天文分类表。

statement.en: HouseSystem identifies explicit Whole Sign, Equal or Placidus requests. A failed request is not silently replaced.
statement.zh: HouseSystem 标识显式的 Whole Sign、Equal 或 Placidus 请求；失败时不静默替换。

citations.locator: astrology 0.0.0 / config.HouseSystem and config.ChartConfig at the recorded commit

prerequisites.en: The caller chooses a HouseSystem member.
prerequisites.zh: 调用方选择一个 HouseSystem 成员。

exceptions.en: The request contract does not supply house geometry.
exceptions.zh: 请求合同不提供宫位几何。

limits.en: No house algorithm, applicability domain or default house system is established by this entry.
limits.zh: 此条目不确立宫制算法、适用域或默认宫制。

statement.en: MEAN and MEEUS_FIVE_TERM_TRUE are distinct named project definition identifiers, not accuracy settings.
statement.zh: MEAN 与 MEEUS_FIVE_TERM_TRUE 是不同的具名项目定义标识，不是精度档位。

citations.locator: astrology 0.0.0 / config.NodeDefinition at the recorded commit

prerequisites.en: Astronomical computation requires a separately implemented and verified model; this catalog does not provide it.

exceptions.en: Neither definition is silently substituted for another.
exceptions.zh: 两种定义不得静默互换。

limits.en: No Meeus book equation, error bound or equivalence to an osculating node has been verified here.
limits.zh: 此处未核验 Meeus 书中方程、误差界或与密切轨道交点的等价关系。

statement.en: LunarNode identities retain both their named definition and ascending/descending direction.
statement.zh: LunarNode 身份同时保留具名定义及升／降方向。

citations.locator: astrology 0.0.0 / config.LunarNode.definition at the recorded commit

exceptions.en: Physical-body identities do not carry a node definition.
exceptions.zh: 物理天体身份不带交点定义。

limits.en: Naming a direction does not compute a node or its motion.
limits.zh: 命名方向不等于计算交点或其运动。

statement.en: MajorAspect provides five admitted identities; AspectRule requires a caller-supplied finite nonnegative orb in degrees.
statement.zh: MajorAspect 提供五种接纳的标识；AspectRule 要求调用方给出以度为单位、有限且非负的容许度。

citations.locator: astrology 0.0.0 / config.MajorAspect and config.AspectRule at the recorded commit

prerequisites.en: A requested aspect requires an explicit orb; applying/separating motion needs a future implementation.
prerequisites.zh: 请求相位须显式给出容许度；入相／出相运动需后续实现。

exceptions.en: An empty aspect request sequence is allowed by ChartConfig.
exceptions.zh: ChartConfig 允许空的相位请求序列。

limits.en: No angle table, orb default, matching or interpretation is supplied.
limits.zh: 不提供角度表、默认容许度、命中判断或解释。

statement.en: Aries and Libra appear in the cited historical equinoctial-sign grouping; this catalog keeps sign names separate from calculation.
statement.zh: 白羊座与天秤座出现在所引历史分点星座分组中；本目录将星座名称与计算分开。

citations.locator: Book I, chapter XIV, printed pp. 34–35; PDF pages 72–73

exceptions.en: The source is a named historical edition, not a universal definition across traditions.
exceptions.zh: 来源是一个具名历史版本，不是跨流派通用定义。

limits.en: The remaining sign names are vocabulary only; no sign degree boundaries or executable classification are asserted.
limits.zh: 其余星座名称仅作词汇，不声明星座度数边界或可执行归属算法。

statement.en: The cited edition groups Aries and Libra as equinoctial signs. Inspecting this passage does not show that a particular chart satisfies any condition.
statement.zh: 所引版本将白羊座与天秤座列为分点星座；查到这段话不表示某张命盘满足任何条件。

citations.locator: Book I, chapter XIV, printed pp. 34–35; PDF pages 72–73; complete equinoctial-sign sentence

excerpt.en: There are also two equinoctial signs: Aries, the first after the vernal equinox; and Libra, the first after the autumnal equinox: they are so called, because the Sun, when in the first point of either, makes the day and night equal.
excerpt.zh: 分点星座也有两个：白羊座，春分之后的第一个；天秤座，秋分之后的第一个。它们如此命名，是因为太阳位于二者任一的起点时，使昼与夜等长。
excerpt.translation_credit: astrology contributors (project Chinese translation of Ashmand's English)

prerequisites.en: A chart-level use would need an explicit zodiac convention, computed position and a separately specified use of this historical grouping; these are not evaluated here.
prerequisites.zh: 若用于命盘，需要显式黄道约定、已计算的位置，以及另行明确的历史分组用法；此处未判断这些前提。

exceptions.en: The historical rationale about equal day and night is preserved, not endorsed as an observed daylight guarantee.
exceptions.zh: 保留历史原文的昼夜等长理由，不将其认可为实际日照时长保证。

limits.en: Single-source, reference-only, non-executable example. Missing prerequisites remain unresolved; computing one condition cannot turn retrieval into full applicability.
limits.zh: 单源、仅供参考、不可执行的例子。缺少的前提保持未决；算出一个条件不能使检索结果变为完全适用。
